residual_risks: Historical backups and retained rollback releases deliberately preserve old directory names; the new live mount contains only neutral assets.
Original finite-viewport/dynamic video/CDN resampling limits remain; a path migration does not rebuild vendor frontend libraries as React components.
Five unused assets already absent from the original backup remain absent; no new missing CSS dependency is introduced.
Newly saved neutral URLs need their mapping retained if a future rollback uses the old renderer.
Official www DNS and external SMTP remain unchanged by this path-only release.
